en: Fixed PushNotification saying a push was not sent in `claude remote-control` sessions right after a phone message, without the `/config` toggle, or when started from inside Claude Code
zh: 修复 PushNotification 在 `claude remote-control` session 中于手机消息后立即提示推送未发送的问题，包括未开启 `/config` 开关或从 Claude Code 内部启动的情况
